GeoRef.entryTitle: View an image beside a map
GeoRef.entryDescription: Enter the URL of an IIIF Manifest or Canvas that carries places
GeoRef.entryHowTo1: Shows an old map or bird’s-eye view (or a 3D model) beside a modern map. Selecting a place picks the same spot on both.

GeoRef.entryHowTo3: Places are read from IIIF Georeference Extension annotations (motivation georeferencing).

Home.developerNames: Satoru Nakamura & Jun Ogawa (The University of Tokyo)
Home.title: IIIF Kasane
Home.subtitle: A viewer that layers IIIF 3D models, images, audio, video and annotations in one view
Home.feature1Description: Rotate and zoom GLB models and point clouds with mouse or touch. Supports the initial view set in the manifest and switching between models placed at the same position.
Home.feature2Description: Deep zoom into IIIF Image API images. Rotated images and Canvases composed from multiple images are displayed as well.
Home.feature3Description: Play audio and video with captions and a time-aligned transcript alongside. Canvases that combine multiple media can also be played.
Home.feature4Description: Annotations on points of 3D models, regions of images and times in audio or video are layered over the resource. Annotations on the same region are grouped, with tags, search and filtering.
Home.feature5Description: Compare two models side by side, or overlaid with swipe and spyglass. Resources with location data are shown together with a map.
Home.feature6Description: Supports tables of contents, paging, two-page spreads and Collections. Share the open resource and position by URL, and embed the viewer in other sites with the iiif-viewer custom element.
Home.step1: 1. Enter the URL of an IIIF Manifest in the form below.
Home.step2: 2. Click the "Open Viewer" button to display the resource.
Home.step3: 3. Rotate and zoom 3D models and images, or play audio and video, with mouse or touch controls.
Home.step4: 4. Annotations, if any, are layered over the resource; click one to see its details.
Home.specP4Note: 3D Scenes, PointSelector and WktSelector targets, and camera annotations.
Home.specP3Note: Converted to the 4.0 form on load.
Home.specP2Note: Converted to the 3.0 form on load.
Home.specImageNote: Used for deep zoom, rotation and thumbnails.
Home.specPhysdimNote: If a Canvas states its real size (how many mm one pixel is), rulers appear along the top and left of the image. Read as a service in Presentation API 2.1 and 3.0.
Home.specContentStateNote: The iiif-content parameter selects the resource, Canvas and region to open.
Home.specAuthNote: Shows images that need consent or a login before viewing (active, kiosk and external profiles). Images only for now.
Home.specContentSearchNote: When a Manifest has a search service, searches its text and marks the hits on the image. Without a service, searches the loaded transcription annotations in your browser (1.0 services are read too).
Home.specDiscoveryNote: Enter the URL of a change stream on the search page to list recently created or updated resources, newest first. Deleted and moved resources are left out.
Home.specGeorefNote: Used by the map viewer. The format, defined for 2D images, is extended to 3D coordinates.
Home.specNavPlaceNote: Shows places attached to Manifests, Canvases, Ranges and Collections in the map tab.
Home.specTextGranularityNote: Shows the text unit of each annotation (page, block, paragraph, line, word, glyph) and filters annotations and search hits by it. Lines from the in-browser OCR carry it too.
Home.specCurationNote: Shows images and regions gathered from several resources, in order, as a single resource. Also readable by the gallery and search.
Home.specRegionTagTitle: Shared Region and Keyed Tag Extension (own extension, draft)
Home.specRegionTagNote: Groups annotations that target the same region, and shows the label of a tag as its key.

InferenceModels.title: Models in the Inference tab
InferenceModels.lead: The machine-learning models you can use in the viewer's Inference tab ({count} models). Each one is downloaded to your browser and runs there. Images are not sent anywhere.
InferenceModels.howTo: How to use: open an image in the viewer, then download a model and run it in the Inference tab on the right. A downloaded model is kept in the browser, so it is ready next time. The results are shown on the image as annotations and can be saved as JSON.
InferenceModels.backend: Models run fast in browsers with WebGPU (Chrome, Edge and others). Without it they run on WebAssembly, which takes longer.
InferenceModels.imageSizeValue: Up to {px} px on the long side

StructureShareEmbed.title: Structure, sharing and embedding
StructureShareEmbed.lead: How Kasane shows the structure of book-like material (tables of contents, two-page spreads, Collections), how to share a view by URL, and how to embed the viewer in other sites. Every example opens as is.
StructureShareEmbed.structureLead: The structure written in the manifest is reflected on screen as it is.
StructureShareEmbed.shareLead: Add these parameters to the viewer URL to choose the resource, page and tab to open. Send the URL, and others open the same view.
StructureShareEmbed.shareCombine: Combine parameters with &. For example, canvas 6 with the metadata tab open:
StructureShareEmbed.contentStateLead: To point at a region on a page, use an IIIF Content State annotation. The last example in the table passes the following annotation, encoded as base64url, in iiif-content.
StructureShareEmbed.embedLead: The iiif-viewer tag embeds the Kasane viewer in a page of your own site. Paste the code below into your HTML and it works; nothing is needed on the server.
StructureShareEmbed.embedFrameTitle: Example of an embedded iiif-viewer tag
StructureShareEmbed.embedFrameNote: The frame above is an HTML page with the code below pasted into it, unchanged.
StructureShareEmbed.embedNoteHeight: The tag fills the height you give it. Set the height with CSS (36rem if you don't).
StructureShareEmbed.embedNoteColor: Colours can be changed from outside with CSS variables such as --iiif-viewer-primary.
StructureShareEmbed.embedNoteCors: The server of the material you show must allow other sites to read it (CORS).
StructureShareEmbed.embedNoteVersion: The v{version} in the script URL is the version of the tag.

Search.title: Search a collection or curation
Search.lead: Enter the URL of a IIIF Collection or a Curation (Curation API) to browse its contents with metadata facets. For a Collection, each Manifest is read to gather its metadata. For a Change Discovery stream, the {max} most recently created or updated Manifests are listed, newest first (deleted and moved ones are left out).
Search.inputLabel: URL of a Collection, Curation or change stream
Search.privacy: Everything is fetched and aggregated in your browser; no URL or image is sent to a server. Servers without CORS support cannot be read.
Search.error: Could not load it. Check that the URL is a Collection, a Curation or a Change Discovery stream and that the server supports CORS.
Search.failed: {count} manifests could not be read (they have no metadata or thumbnail)
